candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on /v1/checkout; the failure originates in the order service, not the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show order 500s but not the internal cause (DB pool, Redis, or payment); the specific fault inside order is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with order service 500s across all sampled correlation IDs; gateway metrics show 16 502s vs 2.7 200s on /v1/checkout. Root cause is inside order, but the specific mechanism is not yet established.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/stack traces for the 500 on POST /v1/orders
Order service dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to identify the failing call
Order service error rate/latency metrics to confirm scope and onset
